Class FlightScene

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.view.graphic.scenes.FlightScene
public class FlightScene extends Object
The FlightScene class represents the graphical user interface component for the flight scene in the game. It manages the layout, components, and user interactions during gameplay
